offers.title: Free online delivery with MyDifference PLUS
offers.criteria: For eligible Woolies Card customers in MyDifference PLUS. Online delivery benefit is subject to programme terms, exclusions and delivery area. Dash eligibility is not confirmed; check before ordering.
offers.evidence: Get free delivery when you shop Woolies online

offers.title: Up to 5% off selected food for seniors
offers.criteria: Age 60+ with a valid Makro mSenior Citizens Card and South African ID or passport. Log in with your registered mSenior Citizens profile. Selected food only; excludes promotions, marketplace sellers, liquor, tobacco, baby formula and delivery fees. Applies automatically at checkout; personal purchases only.
offers.evidence: a discount of up to 5% (five percent) applies to selected food items
